Method of Attack: Exploits a Windows zero-day vulnerability in the Microsoft Support Diagnostic Tool (MSDT) allowing attackers to copy a malicious executable to the Windows Startup folder via a crafted .diagcab file, which executes on system restart
Attack Vector: Opening a maliciously crafted .diagcab file received via email or downloaded from the web, including drive-by downloads and other email clients besides Outlook
Indicators of Compromise: Malicious .diagcab files that exploit the MSDT zero-day vulnerability (DogWalk)
Files bypassing Mark-of-the-Web (MOTW) warnings for .diagcab file type
